title: queue-rs bounded queue
description: The public C ABI enters a bounded Rust queue whose producers and consumers share one mutex-protected deque.

generation.source: Static module and call relationships from examples/data-structures/repositories/queue-rs/src; attribution rows use the folded-sample shape emitted by Linux perf and changed-file lists use repository-relative git paths.

components.label: C ABI
components.description: FFI constructors and queue operations exposed to benchmark callers.

components.label: Queue owner
components.description: Owns queue configuration and shared state handles.

components.label: Producer
components.description: Validates and enqueues one caller-provided value.

components.label: Queue lock
components.description: The synchronization boundary around the bounded deque.

components.label: Bounded deque
components.description: Stores values in FIFO order up to the configured capacity.

components.label: Consumer
components.description: Copies and removes the oldest available value.
